summary: Phase 1 smoke test: All backend endpoints (public + admin CRUD + auth + newsletter CSV export) work. Frontend landing renders Hero3D canvas, 9 catalogue cards, 5 tour rows, newsletter submits with toast, FR->EN i18n switch works (REJOINDRE -> JOIN IN). Admin login/dashboard/logout flow works. Zero console errors.
passed: GET /api/catalogue returns 9 volumes with required fields
GET /api/tour returns 5 dates with id, city, venue, date, status
POST /api/newsletter valid email -> {ok:true, already:false}; duplicate -> {ok:true, already:true}
POST /api/auth/login valid creds returns 200 with token + user{email,role}
POST /api/auth/login wrong password returns 401 Invalid credentials
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns admin user
GET /api/admin/catalogue without token -> 401; with token -> 9 items
Catalogue CRUD: POST/PUT/DELETE full cycle succeeds (PUT requires full body - non-partial)
Tour CRUD: POST/PUT/DELETE full cycle succeeds
GET /api/admin/newsletter/export returns text/csv with content-disposition attachment; filename=newsletter.csv
Landing: Hero3D canvas mounts, GOOD MOOD visible, 9 catalogue cards, 5 tour items, newsletter submit shows Sonner toast
i18n FR->EN: hero-cta-btn text switches REJOINDRE -> JOIN IN
Admin login redirects to /admin, 3 tabs visible (catalogue/tour/newsletter), logout redirects to /admin/login
Zero browser console errors on landing + admin
observations: PUT /api/admin/catalogue/{id} and PUT /api/admin/tour/{id} require ALL fields (Pydantic model non-optional). If admin UI sends partial patch it will 422. Consider Optional fields for partial updates if needed.
POST /api/admin/catalogue expects number as string (not int) per Pydantic model.
